# TaskBakeAI

TaskBakeAI is an Indian-first library of practical AI workflows. Recipes include the task context, reusable prompt, examples, verification guidance, and tools needed to apply a workflow.

## Browse

- [Recipe library](/recipes): browse and search published AI recipes.
- [Categories](/categories): browse recipes by category.
- [Audiences](/audiences): find workflows by audience.
- [About TaskBakeAI](/about): learn about the project and its editorial approach.
- [Privacy](/privacy): read the privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms): read the site terms.

## Use recipes responsibly

Recipes are starting points, not guarantees. Verify AI-generated results and avoid sharing passwords, API keys, payment details, private customer information, or confidential material with AI services.
